data.one_liner: Share text, links or files on iOS and Android
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to share messages, URLs and local files from a Flutter app. It supports both Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You need to share text or links from your app
You need to share local files to other apps
You prefer a minimal dependency for sharing
avoid_when: You are already using the official share plugin or share_plus
You need advanced sharing features like custom intents or platform-specific options
strengths: Simple, single-method API for messages and links
Supports file sharing with optional file type on Android
weaknesses: Discontinued after official plugin added file support
Requires manual Android file provider configuration
data.setup_notes: Android: add FileProvider to AndroidManifest and provider_paths.xml; iOS: ensure use_frameworks! in Podfile

alternatives.name: share_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Officially maintained, supports files, no extra configuration
